sceneDescription: Iziko limele indawo ye-Helia yesikhangeli. Iinodi eziluhlaza ezikhanyayo ngoku ziqhagamshelwe kwisikhangeli kwaye zibe nomgca kwiziko. Iindawo zeViolet zifunyenwe yindlela yokujonga isikhangeli kodwa aziqhagamshelwanga. Iindawo zegolide ziqhagamshelo ezivulekileyo ezichazwe yi-daemon yendawo eyahlukileyo yeKubo; ayilonxibelelwano lomkhangeli zincwadi kwaye akukho mgca kweli ziko. Iinkwenkwezi ezifileyo zeSlate zigcina imbali engadityaniswanga, kwaye umgca wabo wobungqina uyasuswa kuphela emva kokuqhawulwa konxibelelwano. Umgama ukusuka kumbindi weemephu ulinganisa ukubambezeleka; oontanga abangalinganiswanga bahlala kwi-orbit yangaphandle, kunye namaqela e-engile ezothutho ezibonwayo. Iinkwenkwezi ezihombisayo ezingasemva azimelanga iintanga. I-orbit yangaphandle etyhafileyo iphawula indawo yeKubo ethathwe ngaphandle kwaye ayiludibaniso. I-relay edge ibonakala kuphela xa i-ID ye-relay ikhona kwisethi yontanga ephawulweyo; I-topology yoontanga-to-peer engafanelekanga ayinakuze icingelwe. Sebenzisa i-peer explorer kulwazi olufanayo kwifom yesicatshulwa.
fallbackBody: Esi sixhobo asikwazanga ukwenza umxholo okhuselekileyo weWebGL. Ukuqatshelwa okubukhoma kukaHelia kuhlala kufumaneka ngomhloli woontanga.
